translationRepairs: In the ninth year of Huitong (942) he surrendered to Liao together with Du Chongwei.
In the ninth year of Huitong (946) he surrendered to Liao together with Du Chongwei.
會同元年 is AD 938, so 會同九年 is AD 946; the parenthetical (942) is a conversion error, and the proposed (946) matches the Chinese year and the following entry of Taizong into Bian.
Early in the Baoning era he entered palace service as a duty officer and was repeatedly posted to Xuju.
Early in the Baoning era he entered palace service as a duty officer and was repeatedly assigned to demanding posts.
累任珝劇 is a corrupt form of 累任艱劇 (‘repeatedly held arduous/demanding posts’); external witnesses read 艰剧 and do not support a place-name Xuju.
At the beginning of Baoning he became a palace duty officer and was repeatedly assigned to Xuju.
At the beginning of Baoning he became a palace duty officer and was repeatedly assigned to demanding posts.
The same 累任珝劇 corruption should be read as 累任艱劇, so ‘demanding posts’ is correct and ‘Xuju’ as a posting place is unsupported.
